en.name: Hands-on-hips side knee lifts
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with both hands lightly on your hips and space on each side.
Lift one bent knee a little out to the side. Keep the other foot down; use a small lift.
If your teacher asks, add a very small lean towards the lifted knee without pulling or crunching hard.
Put the foot down and return to the middle.
Repeat on the other side, then return to both feet. Do not hop.
en.focus: Teacher marks one lift and return and checks balance and alternating sides; this is movement practice, not a fat-loss target.

zh-Hant.name: 叉腰側提膝
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙手輕輕叉腰站立，左右兩邊留出空間。
把一邊屈曲的膝蓋向外側輕輕提起，另一隻腳留在地上，幅度要小。
老師指示時，可向提膝那邊微微側傾，不要用力拉扯或擠壓身體。
換另一邊，再回到雙腳站立，不要跳躍。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把一次側提膝及放下記作一次，留意平衡與左右交替，以動作練習為目標。
